tools.name: brief_ask
tools.description: Ask Brief for strategic product guidance. Use mode check to validate a direction against existing decisions.

tools.name: brief_get_onboarding_context
tools.description: Load the user's Brief product context before reasoning about their product.

tools.name: brief_search
tools.description: Search Brief for a specific ticket, decision, document, feature, persona, or signal.

tools.name: brief_record_decision
tools.description: Record a decision now with an approval card; only proposes via status: pending on hosts that render that card — on any other host, use brief_propose_decision instead.

status.description: Use confirmed (the default) for a decision the user made. Use pending only to propose a decision for someone else to confirm later. Either status still opens the approval card before persistence.
